assessment: This work describes how the toxin-antitoxin (TA) system, which uses the cyclic di-GMP as an antitoxin, controls both the persistence of antibiotics linked to biofilms and the integrity of the bacterial genome. The authors present solid evidence linking cyclic di-GMP and the toxin HipH. The work is valuable because it establishes the relationship between bacterial persistence and biofilm resilience, which lays a strong basis for future research on the formation of bacterial biofilms and antibiotic resistance.
